scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.format: prettier --write backend/src backend/test frontend/src frontend/vite.config.ts README.md docker-compose.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check backend/src backend/test frontend/src frontend/vite.config.ts README.md docker-compose.yml
